purpose: Phase-4D INTRACELLULAR DRUG RELEASE registry. Defines ONLY: intracellular payload release models, intracellular free-drug spec, cytoplasmic diffusion, intracellular degradation modes, a SCHEMATIC nucleus, and optional nucleus TARGETING. It is a SEPARATE layer that READS the endocytosis / uptake / release outputs and modifies nothing upstream. The code hardcodes NO biology or constants - models, probabilities, degradation, targeting and evidence all live here. NOTHING downstream of nucleus targeting is defined (no DNA/RNA, transcription, translation, receptor signalling, PD, PK, apoptosis, tumour killing, nuclear-pore transport, etc.).
authoritative_source: data/profile-b-evidence-package.json (FROZEN). Chen 2012 reports IN-VITRO (EXTRACELLULAR) release only (first-order). INTRACELLULAR release kinetics, intracellular degradation half-life and nucleus targeting are NOT REPORTED for this NLC. Endosomal escape is also NOT REPORTED (Phase 4C: no_escape), so for B1 no carrier reaches the cytoplasm - the intracellular stage is honestly idle / NOT REPORTED.

release_models.note: Model MATH only (evidence gates WHICH model, if any, a formulation uses). Cumulative released fraction F(t) in [0,1]. Rate constants are supplied per formulation ONLY when evidence exists; absent -> NOT REPORTED (no release).

degradation_modes.note: Degradation mode is evidence-gated. Absent -> NOT REPORTED (no degradation; half-life never fabricated).

partial.meaning: a fraction of drug degrades over time (rate from evidence)

complete.meaning: drug degrades toward full loss over time (rate from evidence)

targeting_modes.note: Nucleus targeting is evidence-gated. Molecules move toward the nucleus ONLY if supported; they STOP at the nuclear membrane and NEVER enter (nuclear-pore transport is a later phase).

none.meaning: no targeting; drug remains in the cytoplasm

passive.meaning: weak, non-specific drift toward the nucleus (only if evidence supports)

evidence_supported.meaning: directed drift toward the nucleus (only with explicit evidence)

molecule.note: An intracellular free drug molecule is an INDEPENDENT object (no chemistry beyond optional degradation; only diffusion). Never merges back into the carrier; never exits the cell; never enters neighbouring cells.

nucleus.note: SCHEMATIC nucleus ONLY: membrane + interior + label. NO DNA, chromosomes, nucleolus, histones, RNA or transcription machinery. Placed concentrically inside each cell.
nucleus.label: Nucleus

formulations.note: Per-formulation intracellular profile (registry data; never hard-coded). For B1 the intracellular stage is NOT REPORTED across the board - Chen reports extracellular release only, no intracellular kinetics/degradation/targeting, and no endosomal escape - so no intracellular free drug is produced. Rate constants are NEVER invented.

B1_nlc.trigger: carrier endocytosis state == CYTOPLASM (post endosomal escape)

intracellular_release.basis: Intracellular release kinetics are NOT REPORTED (Chen 2012 reports in-vitro EXTRACELLULAR release only). No model or rate is assigned.

degradation.basis: Intracellular degradation / half-life is NOT REPORTED for this NLC.

nucleus_targeting.basis: No nucleus-targeting evidence for this NLC (Chen NLC is not nucleus-targeting).

species_intracellular.note: Per-species intracellular-release evidence. For B1 it is NOT REPORTED for all species (not measured intracellularly). No fabricated evidence; no rat->human copy.

rat.message: Intracellular Release Evidence: Not Reported. Intracellular release, degradation and nucleus targeting are not reported for this formulation; no intracellular drug is shown.

human.message: Intracellular Release Evidence: Not Reported. Intracellular release, degradation and nucleus targeting are not reported for this formulation; no intracellular drug is shown.

mouse.message: Intracellular Release Evidence: Not Reported. Intracellular release, degradation and nucleus targeting are not reported for this formulation; no intracellular drug is shown.

integrity.reads_only: The intracellular-release engine READS the endocytosis / uptake / release outputs read-only and modifies NOTHING upstream. Its state (intracellular molecules) lives only in this engine.
integrity.independent_release: Intracellular release is COMPLETELY independent of the extracellular (Phase 4A) release; it has its own model + molecules.
integrity.cytoplasm_only: Intracellular free drug diffuses ONLY inside its own cell's cytoplasm - it never exits the cell and never enters a neighbouring cell.
integrity.no_nuclear_entry: Targeted molecules may STOP at the nuclear membrane but NEVER enter the nucleus. Nuclear-pore / importin / exportin / Ran-GTP / NPC transport are a later phase.
integrity.ends_at: Ends at cytoplasmic diffusion, or (if targeting is supported) at the nuclear membrane. Nothing beyond.

provenance_sources: data/profile-b-evidence-package.json (FROZEN) - Chen 2012 in-vitro (extracellular) first-order release; intracellular release/degradation/targeting NOT REPORTED; endosomal escape NOT REPORTED
Chen Y et al. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033 (DOI 10.2147/IJN.S32476) - primary full-text source
